name: On-the-fly Shell Geometry Construction
definition: A method to construct shell geometry (tetrahedrons/prisms) on the GPU in compute shaders during runtime, ensuring consistency between adjacent prisms without data-dependent preprocessing.
summary: On-the-fly Shell Geometry Construction dynamically generates shell geometry on the GPU during runtime, eliminating static preprocessing by using a deterministic vertex-index rule to ensure consistent, parallelizable prism construction.
